answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint stake-backed cryptographic attestation chains compressed into zero-knowledge proofs. Each interaction requires progressive staking where cost scales exponentially as O(2^k) per registered identity. Legitimate nodes broadcast a genuine signal and harvest economic nectar through cooperative routing, while uncoordinated Sybil swarms amplifying duplicate traffic face superlinear capital exhaustion, turning identity spam into an unaffordable echo.
